_meta.what_this_is: Two sequences of downstream call outcomes a circuit breaker must judge. 'outage' is a real dependency failure: a run of consecutive fails. 'flaky' is a basically-healthy dependency with scattered transient blips -- failures that never run consecutively. A correct breaker should OPEN on the outage (stop hammering a dead service) but stay CLOSED on the flaky one (occasional blips are not an outage). The threshold is how many CONSECUTIVE failures trip it.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. 1 = the call succeeded, 0 = it failed. Hand-authored so the consecutive-failure runs and the trip decisions are exact and checkable.
